'''Mike Elm''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th (last) at [[January 2001 Phoenix tournament]] on 26 January 2001, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1671">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26d1671/ viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-viper-turnss-dark-side-phoenix-az-1-26d1671/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
